import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    keep = []
    seen = set()
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    n_features = len(ids)
    
    for i in range(n_features):
        if i in seen:
            continue
        keep.append(i)
        seen.add(i)
        
        # Find correlated features to skip
        for j in range(i+1, n_features):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                seen.add(j)
    
    # Get kept features
    kept_ids = [ids[i] for i in keep]
    kept_x = feats.x[:, keep]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference by outcome)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(kept_ids):
        y0_mean = np.mean(kept_x[feats.y == 0, i])
        y1_mean = np.mean(kept_x[feats.y == 1, i])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(y1_mean - y0_mean))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    sorted_idx = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    top_ids = [kept_ids[i] for i in sorted_idx[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check if any significant effect exists
    if not top_ids or effect_sizes[sorted_idx[0]] < 0.1:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select top features for regression
    columns = tuple(top_ids)
    
    # Check for interactions between top features
    products = []
    top_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_ids]
    
    # Simple pairwise interaction check
    for i in range(len(top_indices)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_indices)):
            a_idx, b_idx = top_indices[i], top_indices[j]
            # Add interaction term if correlation is strong enough
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, a_idx], feats.x[:, b_idx])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.5:
                products.append((top_ids[i], top_ids[j]))
    
    # Weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(top_ids):
        loadings[fid] = effect_sizes[sorted_idx[i]]
    
    # Limit drivers to at most 4 as per checker report
    drivers = tuple(top_ids[:4]) if len(top_ids) > 4 else tuple(top_ids)
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
